put.summary:
Updates the latest entry for a target. If no health entry exists for the provided target a new health entry will be created.
If this method is called with a computer account, it is only possible to report health on that computer (TargetId and TargetName will be ignored). If called with a user account TargetId and TargetName will be honored.

post.summary:
Creates a new health entry based on the provided information. Any existing health entries will be kept but the new health entry will be considered the latest.
If this method is called with a computer account, it is only possible to report health on that computer (TargetId and TargetName will be ignored). If called with a user account TargetId and TargetName will be honored.

get.summary: Get the available health entries based on the provided information. All calls returns an array even though some request may only match one entry. If no health enties are matched an empty array is returned.
get.description:
Depending on which parameter used the following scenarios are available:
            
* TargetId or TargetName is set and onlyLatest = false: All the health entries for the provided target will be fetched.
* TargetId or TargetName is set and onlyLatest = true: Only the latest health entry for the provided target will be fetched.
* TargetId and TargetName is null (or empty string) and onlyLatest = true: Only the latest health entry for all targets will be fetched. Not recommended for performance reasons.
* TargetId and TargetName is null (or empty string) and onlyLatest = false: NOT supported.

parameters.name: targetId
parameters.description: The id of the target to find health entries for. TargetName can be provided instead. Only works if using SysMan own client health reporting (i.e NOT the client health component provided by Anders Rodland).

parameters.name: targetName
parameters.description: The name of the target to find health entries for. TargetId can be provided instead.

parameters.name: onlyLatest
parameters.description: If only the latest entry should be fetched or all entries.

delete.summary:
Deletes health entries for the provided target (client).
If this method is called with a computer account, it is only possible to delete health on that computer (TargetId and TargetName will be ignored). If called with a user account TargetId and TargetName will be honored.

If the call is made by a device it can identify itself in the following ways:
1. By using Windows Auth token for the device itself (System account). In this case the body of the request can be empty.
2. By signing its own DeviceId/ObjectGUID and provide the auth values in the header or body of the request.
It is preferred to supply DeviceId, CertificatePublicKey and SignedDeviceId as a base64/utf8 encoded json
in the "X-Device-Authentication" header.

to supply DeviceId, CertificatePublicKey and SignedDeviceId as a base64/utf8 encoded json in the "X-Device-Authentication" header.

The password is generated according to the current policy (length and number of non-alphanumeric characters).
A generated password must be verified before it can be retrieved. The verification need to be done within a certain time according to the current policy.
            
The client can authenticate itself in two different ways:
1. By using Windows Auth token for the device itself (System account). In this case the body of the request can be empty.
2. By signing its own DeviceId/ObjectGUID and provide the auth values in the header or body of the request. It is preferred to supply DeviceId, CertificatePublicKey and SignedDeviceId as a base64/utf8 encoded json in the "X-Device-Authentication" header.

ExternalDirectoryReferencePropertyValue.description:
Represent a property value. The reason for this class is to handle partial updates and backward compatibility in a WebAPI. The problem arise when a property on a API model has the value null it is hard to know if the value represent any of the following two scenarios:
  1. The null value should be treated as a reset of the property value (i.e set the value to null)
  2. The null value should be treated as it should be ignored since the caller did not provide any value
By wrapping a property with this class we can distinguish between these scenarios with the following reasoning:
  1. If the whole instance of this class is null then we should ignore the value
  2. If the Value property on this class is null we should set the "backing" property to null
The same reasoning can be applied to support back compatability. When a caller of the API provide a payload that is valid in an older version but does not contain the new properties that was added in the latest version. These values will always be null for the caller since it is not provided.

Int64NullablePropertyValue.description:
Represent a property value. The reason for this class is to handle partial updates and backward compatibility in a WebAPI. The problem arise when a property on a API model has the value null it is hard to know if the value represent any of the following two scenarios:
  1. The null value should be treated as a reset of the property value (i.e set the value to null)
  2. The null value should be treated as it should be ignored since the caller did not provide any value
By wrapping a property with this class we can distinguish between these scenarios with the following reasoning:
  1. If the whole instance of this class is null then we should ignore the value
  2. If the Value property on this class is null we should set the "backing" property to null
The same reasoning can be applied to support back compatability. When a caller of the API provide a payload that is valid in an older version but does not contain the new properties that was added in the latest version. These values will always be null for the caller since it is not provided.

installationType.description:
Gets or sets the type of installation. The following rules applies when calculating which installationType to use:.
  • If installationType is null and template is null then the instalationType will fallback to Required.
  • If installationType is null and template is set and the template does not have any default installationType then the instalationType will fallback to required.
  • If installationType is null and template is set and the template has a default installationType then the template installationType will be used.
  • If installationType is set and template is null then the provided installationType will be used.
  • If installationType is set and template is set (and the installationType and default installationType on template is different) then the template has to allow changing installationType otherwise the call will fail.

Gets or sets if the dependent resources (systems, groups etc.) of the provided target should be uninstalled/removed before the
actual template is applied. Note: The resources will not be cleaned up directly but when the deployment has
actually been performed.
If null the value from the configuration will be used.

Gets or sets the id of the deployment template to use. If a deployment template is associated with a deployment, the template
will be applied when the computer exists in external systems.
I.e Any Systems or Groups associated with the template will not be applied to the computer until it has been
created. Note: If a deployment template is used the Roles list will be considered as an override list. If a role is allowed to be overriden by the template
it can be changed by providing it in the Roles List. If a flag role is part of the template and it is marked as canBeChanged and it is not present in the role list the flag is considered as "unchecked" and will not be added to the deployment.

but the computer configuration (MAC, UEFI etc.) will be stored in external systems.

multiFactorAuthenticationNumber.description: Gets or sets multifactor number associated with the external user.

source.description: Gets or sets the source of the external user.

clientLogins.description: Gets or sets the clients the user has logged in on.

memberships.description: Gets or sets the group memberships.

installedSystems.description: Gets or sets the installed systems in SysMan.

collections.description: Gets or sets the collections (collectionIds) that this client is member of in ConfigMgr.

inventoryData.description: Gets or sets inventory data about the client. The inventory data is populated using the datasheet API in SysMan.

applicationDeployments.description: Gets or sets the application deployments in ConfigMgr.

fullTags.description: Gets or sets all tags for a user with full information about each tag.

userName.description: Gets or sets the username of the user.

userPrincipalName.description: Gets or sets the UPN of the user.

alternateLogon.description: Gets or sets the alternate logon.

isActive.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether if the item is active.

id.description: Gets or sets the id of the item.

name.description: Gets or sets the name of the item. Often displayed to the user.

description.description: Gets or sets the description of the item. Often used in tooltips.

tag.description: Gets a tag that is attached on the search item.

tags.description: Gets or sets the tags of this search item.

result.description: Gets or sets the result of the paged data.

totalCount.description: Gets or sets the actual total count of the paged date. Example: Result.Count = 10, TotalCount = 20.

UserSearchItemPagedResult.description: Represent a result that has been paged.

url.description: Gets the url to the api endpoint.

appCertificateThumbprint.description: Gets the thumbprint of the certificate to use.

ValidateGraphCredentialsCommand.description: Represents a request to validate credentials for connecting to Microsoft Graph.

apiKey.description: Gets or sets the api key.

tenantId.description: Gets or sets the tenant id.

appId.description: Gets or sets the app id.

appSecret.description: Gets or sets the secret to use. If none provided the currently stored secret will be used.

appCertificateThumbprint.description: Gets or sets the certificate thumbprint. If none provided the AppSecret attribute will be used.

appAuthType.description: Gets or sets the Entra ID auth type.

resource.description: Gets or sets the resource to validate the connection agains.

url.description: Gets or sets the api endpoint to try oauth credentials against.

path.description: Gets or sets the path to the container.

type.description: Gets or sets the type of the resource container.

clientIdentifier.description: Gets or sets the client identifier to use.

server.description: Gets or sets the server where the sql database is located.

database.description: Gets or sets the name of the database.

siteServer.description: Gets or sets the site server.

siteCode.description: Gets or sets the site code.

isValid.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether if the verification was valid.

reason.description: Gets or sets if IsValid = false then the error message is stored here.

reasonDetails.description: Gets additional information about the error message (reason).

VerificationResult.description: The result from a verification attempt.

deviceId.description: Gets or sets the device ID of the device who is verifying its password.

verificationKey.description: Gets or sets the verification key of the password to be verified.

type.description:
Gets or sets the type of filter.
Can be None, Gpo or OrgIds. Possible values: { Gpo, OrgIds }.

orgIds.description: Gets or sets allowed OrgIds. Will be empty unless Type is OrgIds.

hash.description: Gets or sets the hash value. Is a base64 encoded SHA256 hash of the latest stored recovery key.

result.description: Gets or sets the result. Possible values: { Ok, Disclosed, NotFound }.

shouldRotate.description:
Gets or sets a value indicating whether should the recovery key for the volume be rotated.
Will be true if the volume doesn't have any undisclosed keys.

forceManagement.description:
Gets or sets a value indicating whether force management setting
If. ```true``` the volume should be managed if it is already encrypted and doesn't match the OrgIdFilter policy.

nameSpace.description: Gets or sets the namespace in which the WQL filter query is executed.

query.description: Gets or sets the query string for filtering system management information.

WqlFilter.description: Represents a WQL (WMI Query Language) filter for system management queries.
